sourceInspection: Existing InterpolationArrayFact records are produced only for lowered interpolation nodes; ordinary record-field arrays have no such fact. The first source-emitter build therefore preserved the old 23/1 and24/1 metadata differences.

Ordinary resolveContextCore retains finalized expectedContextByAst and expressionTypeIds after path resolution, but does not retain the fixed backing type allocated by CSharp contextual literal inference.
decision: Register ordinary fixed backing identities from finalized source literal syntax and contextual element types before the semantic type arena is frozen. Preserve source/AST/type facts and consume them using the same active-source and transitive-concreteness admission as expression facts. Explicit dynamic/bounded syntax does not create an extra fixed backing record.
